import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Identify numeric indicator columns (excluding city_id, city_name, year)
# Assuming first 3 columns are identifiers
numeric_cols = [col for col in df.columns[3:] if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col])]

# Impute missing values with median
for col in numeric_cols:
    df[col] = df[col].fillna(df[col].median())

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(df[numeric_cols])

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_data)

# Add cluster_id to dataframe
df['cluster_id'] = cluster_labels

# Write city clusters
city_clusters = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'cluster_id']].copy()
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Write cluster profiles (mean profile per cluster)
cluster_profiles = df.groupby('cluster_id')[numeric_cols].mean().reset_index()
cluster_profiles.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False)
